name: Evolutionary agent population and autoresearch strategy factory
one_line: Evolve a quality-diversity archive of agents whose fitness is marginal contribution to the market-anchored blend. Run a leakage-guarded autoresearch loop that proposes structural strategies. Breed new agents by recombining modules that carry positive PnL attribution.
scope: Cover population-level self-improvement. A MAP-Elites archive over model family, information diet and niche, with Numerai-MMC-style leave-one-out fitness, so that selection buys orthogonality and not another copy of the consensus. GEPA-style reflective prompt mutation. A keep-or-revert autoresearch loop over the full trade archive, restricted to point-in-time tool registries, with thresholds deflated by trial count and an untouched event-clustered holdout. Compositional breeding of typed modules (signal, sizing, execution) using an attribution ledger. An ecological co-evolution gym that replays the team's own L2 books against reactive rival archetypes, including fee and tick perturbations taken from the changelog. Include the hard negatives: honest evaluation rejected every LLM-discovered equity strategy, a leaky Sharpe-35 oracle passed DSR and PBO, 70% of mutations were reverted, and greedy search is a strong default. Include the hobby systems elastifund and atlas-gic, and the builder-fee commercial layer. Validation: planted-edge recovery, sim-to-live rank agreement, top-k chosen by marginal contribution vs top-k chosen by own Brier. Boundary: promotion statistics are in evaluation-promotion-allocation-metalayer.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Quality-diversity agent population with marginal-contribution (MMC-style) fitness
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Evolve a MAP-Elites archive of forecaster agents whose fitness is their leave-one-out contribution to the market-anchored blend, not their own Brier or Sharpe, so that selection pressure buys orthogonality instead of a better copy of the consensus.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: (1) Archive cells are behaviour descriptors: base-model family, information diet (news only, primary documents, order flow, non-English sources, base-rate tables), reasoning style, market niche. (2) Fitness of an agent = change in the blend's market-relative proper score when the agent is removed (Numerai's Meta Model Contribution idea), estimated on post-cutoff resolved markets plus forward paper. (3) Mutations are LLM-written: reflective prompt edits from post-mortems (GEPA style), retrieval-source swaps, deliberately partitioned evidence so agents hold private slices. (4) Keep-or-revert per cell; an accurate agent that is 0.9-correlated with incumbents is culled. (5) Capital goes to the blend, never to individual agents.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Informational and model diversity that other LLM-bot operators do not select for; the pool's effective number of independent forecasters rises from about 1.4 toward the number of genuinely different information diets.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Agent count is not diversity: DPO-tuned agents have error correlation 0.70, N_eff stays flat from 5 to 40 agents, a ten-agent market scored 67.6% vs 70.2% for one agent; cross-family mixing cuts rho from 0.68 to 0.40. Partitioned evidence improves Brier 12-18% on 375 prediction-market questions and the gain disappears when all agents see the same evidence. Four frontier agents gave the identical top pick in 92% of World Cup matches and none beat the bookmaker. Standard keep-if-Sharpe-improves loops therefore converge to the consensus everyone else's bot holds. Honest limit: a diverse pool mostly narrows the gap to the price; it cannot invent non-public information, and novelty rarely tops quality (Heuresis: one novel idea in the top ten of 3,222 scored runs).
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: Who does it on Polymarket/Kalshi: single-lineage keep/revert variants exist (bennyjo/phil on Polymarket, paper; chrisworsey55/atlas-gic on equities with a Kalshi mention: 54 prompt mutations, 16 survived, fitness = rolling Sharpe over 5 trading days, +22% in 173 days self-reported), none with diversity-aware fitness. Adjacent field: open-ended agent evolution (Darwin Godel Machine: SWE-bench 20.0% to 50.0% via an archive of self-modified agents; ADAS meta agent search; GEPA: +6% on average over GRPO with 35x fewer rollouts), Population Based Training (DeepMind 2017), co-evolving LoRA populations (PopuLoRA: population mean beats the best single agent on 10 benchmarks), Numerai's staked Meta Model with MMC scoring, LLM quality-diversity search (IDEAgent 2607.22375, AgenticGEO 2603.20213).
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Fitness noise far larger than fitness differences (a 5-day Sharpe window is statistically meaningless); mode collapse back to the dominant model family; Goodharting on the replay set; leave-one-out estimates unstable with correlated members; cost scales with population x markets x checkpoints; 'Greedy is a strong default' (2603.27415) - elaborate evolution may not beat simple hill climbing.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Offline on >= 300 markets opened after every model's training cutoff: build 12 agents (3 model families x 4 information diets). Metrics: mean pairwise error correlation and leave-one-out blend Brier. Pass: mean rho <= 0.45 AND a 5-agent set chosen by marginal contribution beats the top-5-by-own-Brier set by >= 0.003 blend Brier with event-clustered CI above zero. Fail: marginal-contribution selection is no better than top-k.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Autoresearch strategy factory with structural leakage guards and search-aware deflation
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Coding agents continuously propose, implement and backtest structural (not predictive) strategies on the full Polymarket trade archive, but can only act through point-in-time tools, every trial is counted against them, and only forward paper results unlock capital.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: (1) A keep-or-revert autoresearch loop generates hypotheses about structural quirks: calibration pockets by category x price band x time to close, maker-side ladders, listing-time and weekend effects, negative-risk conversion timing, post-dispute drift. (2) Agents may only call registry-validated point-in-time feature tools over the archive (public datasets now cover 1.20 billion trades / 1.30 million markets, plus own L2 recordings), so look-ahead is excluded by construction rather than by review. (3) Every evaluation is logged and the pass threshold is deflated by the agent's own trial count. (4) Final judgement uses an event-clustered, time-forward holdout the agents never see, with fills modelled at queue position and the documented taker delay. (5) Survivors enter the promotion ladder; everything else is archived as a negative result so the loop does not rediscover it.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Breadth of search over a young, frequently re-parameterised venue, with far more independent ground-truth outcomes than any equity backtest, and precise factor definitions that naive analyses get wrong.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Definitions matter: purchases below 10c lose 19.3c per dollar contract-by-contract but gain 4.1c once contracts are grouped by parent event, so a careful searcher finds pockets a casual one mis-signs. A solo practitioner found a NO-side maker edge on Kalshi mention markets via Claude-Code-assisted calibration analysis: $5,515.94 net on $342,506.13 cost over 2,717 settled markets, while his LLM-probability approach lost money. Honest limit: on equities, honest evaluation 'rejects every LLM-discovered strategy' (two frontier models, up to 100 candidates, five runs) and a leaky oracle with Sharpe 35 passed Deflated Sharpe and PBO; expect more than 90% of candidates to die (elastifund: 10 tested and rejected in cycle one; atlas-gic: 70% of mutations reverted), and survivors to be capacity-limited.
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: Who does it on Polymarket/Kalshi: CrunchyJohnHaven/elastifund ('research -> implement -> test -> record -> publish', live on Polymarket and Kalshi, self-reported +$131.52 on 128 contracts, wallet $458.13, promotion gate currently failing); McInerney's manual version on Kalshi. Adjacent field: LLM-driven code evolution for quant alpha (CogAlpha 2511.18850; AlphaAgent 2502.16789 with alpha-decay regularisation; Agora 2606.29194: sealed information flow, 91-day holdout Sharpe 1.87 vs 1.334; EVOQUANT 2607.12455: average test Sharpe -0.298 to 0.538; XAlpha 2607.08332), karpathy/autoresearch (96k stars) and its trading port atlas-gic, and the honest-evaluation critique 2608.27734.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Search-induced overfitting; look-ahead through resolution timestamps, post-hoc edited market metadata and survivorship in archives; backtest fills at displayed depth ignore queue position and ghost fills; discovered edges are tiny in size (NBA combinatorial episodes: median 101 bps, 76.9% limited to 14.8 shares); decay after publication; auto-generated code risk.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Step 1, planted-edge test: inject 3 synthetic edges and 1 deliberately leaky feature into a copy of the archive; pass if the loop recovers >= 2 planted edges and the tool registry blocks the leak. Step 2, real run of 200 candidates: pass if >= 1 survives the trial-count-deflated test on the untouched holdout AND 4 weeks of forward paper with net PnL > 0 over >= 300 simulated fills. Fail: zero survivors - then keep the loop only as a hypothesis generator for humans.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Auto-generated trading code must never reach live keys without human review; no third-party repo code is executed.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Agent OS as the strategy: compositional breeding of verified strategy modules (plus builder-code monetisation)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Decompose every working bot into typed modules with a PnL-attribution ledger, let a meta-agent breed new agents by recombining modules that carry positive attribution in adjacent cells, gate them through guarded backtests and the promotion ladder, and optionally earn builder fees by offering proven agents to other users.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: (1) Standardise module types: universe filter, signal, fair-value blend, sizing rule, execution style (maker skew vs taker), exit/hedge, risk gate. (2) Maintain an attribution ledger per module and per edge-map cell using ablation / leave-one-out replays. (3) A meta-agent proposes compositions whose parents have positive attribution in neighbouring cells - for example copy-trading wallet-skill filter x LLM fair-value blend x LP quote-skew execution - writes the glue code, and submits it to the guarded backtest and the e-value ladder. (4) Promotion is sparse and versioned in git (keep/revert); a harness tree routes each market to the agent that owns its cell. (5) Commercial layer: Polymarket's Builder Program allows an app to add up to 100 bps taker / 50 bps maker on orders it routes, so agents with a public forward record can earn on other people's flow.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Pre-validated building blocks with measured attribution - an asset the owner's existing LP, cross-venue arb, sniping and copy-trading bots already generate and that newcomers must build from zero.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Recombination searches a space of roughly 5^7 = 78k compositions using parts that already passed validation, which is far cheaper than evolving from raw prompts. Evidence that combinations beat parts: forecaster + market blend 0.106 vs 0.1106 market alone; openthomas reached break-even only after combining three fixes; LLM-evolved heuristic portfolios with a selector beat individual evolved rules in scheduling (DSevolve). Honest limit: interaction effects are estimated on small samples, most compositions are redundant, attribution under correlated modules is ill-posed, and no one has shown compositional breeding of trading agents working live.
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: Who does it on Polymarket/Kalshi: platform layer only - Olas Polystrat (user-owned autonomous Polymarket agents, vendor says about 37% had positive PnL), elastifund ('self-improving agentic operating system', self-reported, tiny), Polymarket/agent-skills (static skills, 188 stars, no feedback loop). Adjacent field: Automated Design of Agentic Systems (Meta Agent Search over an archive of agents, transfers across domains), Darwin Godel Machine, Adaptive Auto-Harness (stateful multi-agent evolver + harness tree, tested on prediction-market streams), FINSKILLOPS (controlled skill patches, 6 of 33 promoted), coordination as an architectural layer tested on 100 Polymarket markets (two of five configurations dominate the Pareto frontier), DSevolve (2603.27628).
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Attribution noise and combinatorial multiple testing; capital interference between agents (self-crossing, conflicting inventory); operational risk of auto-generated code with live keys; module interfaces ossify; for the commercial layer: user-paid builder fees make marginal agents net-negative for customers, creating reputational and regulatory exposure.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Retro test on your own logs: compute module attributions on months 1-3, let the meta-agent propose 10 compositions, evaluate on months 4-6 replay plus 4 weeks forward paper. Pass: >= 2 of 10 compositions beat their best parent net of costs with event-clustered CI above zero. Fail: none beats parents - then the OS's value is operational (speed of building), not alpha.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Offering trading agents to third parties for a fee may trigger adviser/CTA-type regulation depending on jurisdiction; Polymarket international vs US-exchange terms and geo-restrictions apply; builder fees are paid by the end user on top of platform fees.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Ecological co-evolution gym: evolve agents against a simulated population of rival bots
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: A replay-plus-agents simulator built from your own L2 recordings in which parametrised rival archetypes react to your orders; candidate agents are selected for robustness across ecologies and rule perturbations rather than best-case backtest PnL.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: (1) Replay recorded books for a market family and overlay reactive models of known archetypes: reward-farming LPs quoting at fixed offsets, resolution snipers, copy-traders keyed to leader wallets, LLM takers, zero-intelligence noise. (2) Calibrate archetype parameters so that simulated spread, depth and fill statistics match your live logs. (3) Evolve candidate agents under selection, innovation and environmental perturbation (fee-rate, tick-size and taker-delay changes taken from the real changelog). (4) Fitness = worst-quartile PnL across ecologies. (5) Survivors go to forward paper via the promotion ladder; sim-to-live rank agreement is tracked as the simulator's own score.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Other bots' rigid, observable rules. In thin books your order changes others' behaviour, which static backtests ignore; a co-evolved agent learns to trade against mechanical counterparties and to survive rule changes.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: In ecological market games strategies 'dominate, collapse, or form coalitions depending on their competitors', patterns invisible to static backtests; on Kalshi replay with maker/taker semantics and fees, naive agents lose to friction while fee-aware algorithmic strategies stay competitive. Polymarket's bot population is unusually legible (public wallets, open-source bot templates with hundreds of forks), which makes archetype modelling more feasible than in equities. Honest limit: the sim-to-real gap is the whole risk; rival models are guesses; execution artefacts such as reverted fills are hard to simulate.
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: Who does it on Polymarket/Kalshi: PredictionMarketBench offers Kalshi replay with fees but no reactive rivals; nothing co-evolutionary found. Adjacent field: FinEvo ecological market games (2602.00948), LLM traders in a persistent order book (Lopez-Lira 2504.10789), replay simulators for recursive self-improvement (Dream-RSI 2609.14858), Population Based Training (1711.09846 [pre-2025, possibly stale]).
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Overfitting to the simulator; mis-specified rivals; emergent collusion artefacts; compute cost; unmodelled venue pathologies - 24.3% of filled orders reverted during peak hours in one study of ghost fills; rule changes invalidate calibration.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Build the simulator for one liquid and one thin market family only. Metric: Spearman correlation between simulated and realised live ranking of 10 existing in-house strategy variants, and simulated vs live fill rates. Pass: rho >= 0.6 and fill rates within +/-20%, clearly better than the static backtest's rank agreement. Fail: no better than static backtest - shelve.

critic_notes: evolutionary-agent-strategy-factory: the sub-variant 'Builder-code monetisation of proven agents' contradicts the E6 pack. The median builder could gross at most about $300 a month at the 100 bps cap. Every fill routed through a builder code is publicly enumerable with maker address and owner id, and codes are revocable for 'automated' or 'self-referred' flow. A proven strategy routed through a labelled code is leaked. Move monetisation to the services band and delete it here.
